definition: A statement is self-evident in this corpus when its record carries a `self_evident` marking whose justification ids are sourced claims or results: the marking is itself a challengeable, argued claim, not a bare flag (docs/corpus-model.md).
note: Project schema (#156, #167). It is not yet tied to the classical per se nota of ST I q.2 a.1, which has no pinned passage; STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE is marked on Aristotle's elenctic defence, not on per se nota.
